patterns: RuntimeError: Expected all tensors to be on the same device
entries.title: ONNX export shape mismatch
entries.root_cause: Input shapes or dynamic_axes are not correctly specified; or the model contains control flow that depends on runtime shape.
entries.solution: Add dynamic_axes to OnnxConversion for batch/sequence dims; trace with representative input shapes; replace data-dependent control flow with fixed-shape equivalents.

entries.title: ONNX model exceeds 2GB
entries.root_cause: ONNX protobuf cannot store tensors larger than 2GB.
entries.solution: Enable use_external_data_format=True; Olive will write weights to a separate .onnx_data file.

entries.title: Quantized model accuracy collapse
entries.root_cause: Calibration data is not representative, per-channel quantization is disabled for CNNs, or asymmetric scheme is used on an accelerator that requires symmetric.
entries.solution: Use 100-300 representative samples; enable per_channel=True for CNN/Linear layers; switch to symmetric quantization for QNN/CoreML; evaluate with a held-out set.

entries.title: Execution provider silent fallback to CPU
entries.root_cause: The requested execution provider does not implement one or more operators; ONNX Runtime falls back to CPU.
entries.solution: Check EP operator support; add OnnxModelOptimizer to fuse unsupported patterns; consider OnnxOpVersionConversion to a supported opset; enable verbose ORT logging.

entries.title: Out of memory during quantization or tuning
entries.root_cause: Calibration batch or intermediate tensors exceed GPU memory.
entries.solution: Reduce calibration_sampling_size and batch_size; move to CPU for calibration; use weight-only quantization; enable external data format for large models.

entries.title: Calibration data mismatch or missing
entries.root_cause: Static quantization requires a DataConfig with calibration samples that match the model input format and preprocessing.
entries.solution: Define a data_config with correct input_names, batching, and preprocessing; use representative samples from the inference distribution.

entries.title: LoRA target modules not found
entries.root_cause: target_modules do not match the model architecture (e.g. using q_proj/v_proj for a BERT model).
entries.solution: Inspect model keys and set target_modules correctly: Llama/Mistral use q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj; BERT uses query/key/value/dense.

entries.title: TensorRT engine build is very slow or fails
entries.root_cause: INT8 TensorRT requires per-engine calibration and explicit QDQ placement; dynamic shapes enlarge the search space.
entries.solution: Use static shapes where possible; pre-generate calibration cache; enable OnnxStaticQuantization with QDQ format before TensorRT; reuse engine files.

entries.title: AWQ calibration is slow or hangs
entries.root_cause: AWQ scans weights and activations; large models or large calibration sets take time.
entries.solution: Reduce calibration iters to 32; use a small subset (128 samples); ensure GPU memory is available.

entries.title: QNN reports unsupported operator
entries.root_cause: Qualcomm QNN has a limited op whitelist; LayerNorm and GELU are often unsupported.
entries.solution: Run QNNPreprocess before QNNQuantization; use OnnxModelOptimizer to fuse LayerNorm; consider replacing GELU with approximate ops if the model allows.

entries.title: CoreML conversion fails with dynamic shapes
entries.root_cause: CoreML prefers fixed input shapes; dynamic batch or sequence length can fail.
entries.solution: Fix input shapes by removing dynamic_axes in OnnxConversion; use symbolic shape inference carefully.

entries.title: LoRA adapter cannot be merged into quantized base
entries.root_cause: Merging adapters into a 4-bit or quantized base model is not supported by Olive.
entries.solution: Merge LoRA weights into the full-precision base model before ONNX conversion; then quantize the merged ONNX model.

entries.title: OpenVINO silently falls back to CPU EP
entries.root_cause: OpenVINO Execution Provider does not support some ops or data types.
entries.solution: Check OpenVINO operator support; use OnnxModelOptimizer to fuse unsupported patterns; convert to OpenVINO IR for broader op support.

entries.title: Transformer optimization fails due to missing dims
entries.root_cause: OrtTransformersOptimization needs num_heads and hidden_size for attention fusion.
entries.solution: Set num_heads and hidden_size in pass params; verify against model config.

entries.title: INT4 quantization causes large perplexity increase
entries.root_cause: INT4 weight quantization is aggressive; small models or sensitive layers suffer.
entries.solution: Use group size 128 or 64; exclude lm_head and embedding layers from quantization; try AWQ or GPTQ with larger group size.

entries.title: FP16 conversion produces NaN/Inf
entries.root_cause: Model activations exceed FP16 range or are not trained for FP16.
entries.solution: Keep I/O types float32; cast int inputs to int32; exclude sensitive ops from FP16; consider mixed precision.

entries.title: Calibration data distribution mismatch
entries.root_cause: Calibration samples do not match inference inputs; quantization scale/zp are wrong.
entries.solution: Use production-like data; cover min/max sequence lengths and vocabulary; avoid synthetic or unrelated samples.

entries.title: Multi-pass run overwrites intermediate outputs
entries.root_cause: Pass output names collide or cache_dir is shared across runs.
entries.solution: Set unique output_name per pass; use separate cache_dir per experiment; clean cache between unrelated runs.

entries.title: Search finds poor local optimum
entries.root_cause: Objective weights or search space are not tuned; evaluator is noisy with small sample size.
entries.solution: Fix seed for reproducibility; use larger calibration/evaluation sets; adjust objective weights; try bayesian or evolutionary search.

entries.title: TorchScript export fails for a HuggingFace model
entries.root_cause: Many HF models use control flow or data-dependent shapes that TorchScript cannot trace.
entries.solution: Use OnnxConversion instead of TorchScript export; configure dynamic_axes for variable dimensions.
